verdict.rationale: Cursor's security page documents a Privacy Mode that users or admins can enable so Cursor does not train on their data, and accounts can be deleted at any time from the Settings dashboard. Both are org-wide Cursor controls, and neither addresses Bugbot specifically or sets retention periods. missing for 10: configurable retention windows or a zero-retention option, Bugbot-specific controls for deleting PR diffs, comments and review data, documented deletion timelines, independent corroboration.
